what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Cambodia by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025 both sources give the same figure, 517555 people.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Cambodia and Thailand in 2011 and again in 2025.
Floods, storms and mass movements are the disasters recorded for Cambodia in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's conflict figures for Cambodia start in 2025, the main year of displacement in the data and a year in which UCDP records the conflict with Thailand.
That year IDMC recorded 821257 new displacements from conflict.
UNHCR's earlier figures for people displaced inside Cambodia go back to 1994.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people, so they can be higher than the number of people still displaced at the end of the year.
UNHCR's and IDMC's figures overlap and are counted differently, so they are shown side by side and never added.
The sources don't say where inside Cambodia people moved to.
